releases.summary: Exact Snapshot History Mirror Gate: persistence source correction mirrors into snapshot history only on an exact source timestamp match. The prior same-session/same-bucket fallback was removed; missing or unmatched timestamps fail closed and are recorded instead of mutating another intrahour snapshot. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

Runtime Error Boundary: captures TAG500-owned script-load failures and critical JavaScript exceptions, records them in Data Integrity, and makes Executive Mode fail closed when runtime safety is compromised. Network-style promise failures remain warnings rather than automatic model failures. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

Late-Bound Outermost Runtime Boundary: Runtime Safety now attaches after the complete render-wrapper chain exists, automatically re-attaches if later overlays replace render, and catches failures thrown by the outermost UI/runtime layers. Critical runtime errors remain fail-closed; transient network failures remain warnings. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

RTH→AH Volume Handoff: direct ahVolume remains preferred, but when it is absent TAG500 may derive After-Hours Volume Participation/Takeover from the same-day central R15 volume baseline versus the current total volume only when the extended-hours volume field is demonstrably moving and non-frozen. Missing/contradictory baselines remain fail-closed. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

Strict Final Snapshot Authority: a dedicated 20:00-20:10 ET final-AH capture eliminates the boundary race that could classify the 8:00 PM run as CLOSED. A v2 reconciliation compares the strict Finviz candidate with live Yahoo chart price/change. 19:55-19:59 remains intraperiod; final volume stays blocked because Yahoo 1m extended-hours volume is not cumulative-session volume. The page loads the authority dynamically from current-release metadata. No scoring or threshold retune.

Nearest-Timestamp Final Reconciliation: replaces the v2 latest-bar-within-window comparison with v3 nearest-time matching. Yahoo's selected 1-minute bar must be the closest timestamp to the strict Finviz 20:00+ candidate, and the runtime verifies the v3 schema/matching policy before allowing any reconciled final price/change or mover-outcome label. Final volume remains blocked; no scoring or threshold retune.

Final Authority Activation & Release Consistency: detected that the actual public entrypoint was still TAG573 while release metadata had advanced to TAG575, so the strict 20:00+ Final Snapshot Authority and v3 nearest-timestamp reconciliation were not actually loaded. TAG576 unifies the entrypoint/cache-busters/visible release identity and loads the release-aware final authority before the 8:00 PM window. Final mover outcomes stay fail-closed unless strict capture + v3 nearest-time reconciliation + two independent sources pass; final AH volume remains training-blocked. No scoring or threshold retune.

Same-Session Final Reconciliation Gate: reconciliation v4 now requires the strict 20:00+ candidate to be from the same ET trading date as the reconciliation run. A prior-session candidate is explicitly blocked instead of being reprocessed as a fresh final artifact. Runtime Final Authority accepts only v4 nearest-timestamp reconciliation with same-session date verification and at least two independent sources for price/change outcome labels. Final AH volume remains training-blocked; no scoring or threshold retune.

Premarket Cold-Start Data Readiness + Release Runtime Ownership: during the first 10 minutes after 04:00 ET, missing or prior-session data is classified as waiting for the first current-session PM snapshot rather than a generic feed failure, while Executive Mode remains fail-closed. A 30-second retry cadence applies only inside the startup window. Release History no longer injects Final Snapshot Authority dynamically, removing an obsolete-authority race and ensuring the entrypoint owns runtime modules. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.
